title: Charis Stengos (Quento MD, LEADEER author) — '#Incorruptible provides the structural armor that ensures that engine survives the market'
summary: Charis Stengos — Managing Director of Quento (Qualco Group, Romania), author of LEADEER, ex-Google and ex-Microsoft executive — frames Incorruptible as the structural complement to his own work on individual leadership virtue: personal ethos hits a wall at market scale; only governance design can carry the values across.
blockquote: LEADEER provides the engine of culture, habits, and human potential. #Incorruptible provides the structural armor that ensures that engine survives the market. Eric has written a masterpiece that shows us how to scale integrity from the human heart to the legal corporate charter. It is an absolute MUST-READ.
attribution_title: MD at Quento (Qualco Group); author of LEADEER; ex-Google, ex-Microsoft
